title: The Kobon triangle problem on triangles in line arrangements
exact_target: How many triangular cells can an arrangement of a prescribed number of straight lines produce?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 7200050 (AMR-071-0050). CC BY 4.0.
